## Problem and change

Describe the user-visible change and why it belongs in the core.

## Verification

- [ ] Deterministic tests added/updated and passing
- [ ] Mocked vs. live-environment evidence clearly distinguished
- [ ] Offline demo still works without optional adapters
- [ ] Release-content checks pass
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated when needed
- [ ] No secrets, internal endpoints, real desktop captures, or proprietary scenarios
- [ ] Third-party licenses and notices preserved

## Risks and limitations

Explain cancellation, input side effects, new dependencies, or untested platforms.
